claim: GWAS Catalog rs1250550 association rows preserve a disease-specific allele-direction contrast at ZMIZ1: the multiple-sclerosis row lists rs1250550-A as the risk allele with OR 1.10, while a Crohn disease row lists rs1250550-G as the risk allele with OR 1.19.
future_grounding_route: Use the association row IDs as a source-specific intake packet for future allele-harmonized MS/Crohn direction grounding; do not treat the external rows as rerun project evidence.
project_use: Sharper external convergence record for V50 reassessment of the ZMIZ1 direction-dependent decoupling finding.
relationship_note: This is a source-specific convergence candidate because it preserves the same rsid, disease labels, effect alleles, and odds-ratio direction needed for a head-to-head comparison; allele harmonization still belongs in a future grounding task.

source.citation: NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog association rows for rs1250550 queried through the public REST API.
source.label: GWAS Catalog ZMIZ1 rs1250550 MS/Crohn association rows

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: GWAS Catalog public API metadata; metadata-only reuse in V50
source_terms.reuse_notes: V50 stores source metadata and a short paraphrased claim only; do not treat API content as project-grounded evidence.

why_unverifiable: The project has not rerun the underlying GWAS Catalog curation, allele harmonization, or cross-disease summary-statistic analysis in the external layer.
